title: A pay-off place names the debt it pays down (`pays`): its money is set aside like any place and is not a payment (SCHEMA_V3 4; X watch decided)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000, of which 50,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed). A car loan owes 500,000 and asks 20,000 on the 10th (moved later), paid from the bank. The place Pay off the car (kind payoff) names the car loan in `pays`; a pay-off place is never opened as savings, so it starts at nothing. On Wed 6 Jan the person sets 100,000 aside in it. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier); Free to spend is 50,000 a month. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: place
asks.why: 0 (opening: a pay-off place is never opened as savings) + 100,000 (set aside Wed 6 Jan) = 100,000

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 500,000 (owed at the opening; money set aside to pay it off is not a payment) = 500,000

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 300,000 (Bank today) - 100,000 (Pay off the car, kept in it) - 20,000 (Car loan 11 Jan) = 180,000
